# Smart List (Smart Fridge)

> Intelligent grocery inventory management, real-time freshness tracking, multi-list shopping, and automated household restock forecasting.

Smart List is a responsive full-stack web application engineered to eliminate domestic food waste and simplify grocery logistics. It unifies pantry inventory tracking, expiration date monitoring, categorized shopping list creation, and grocery budgeting into a single responsive platform.

## Core Capabilities
- [Inventory Management](/): Track groceries across 10 food categories and 7 refrigerator/pantry storage zones with exact quantities and units.
- [Freshness Alerts](/): Real-time freshness status evaluation (Fresh, Expiring Soon, Expires Today, Expired) using deterministic date calculations.
- [Multi-Shopping Lists](/): Create, customize, and maintain multiple segregated shopping lists (e.g. Weekly Essentials, Farmers Market).
- [Budget Tracking](/): Real-time estimation of grocery trip expenses distinguishing pending items from purchased goods.
- [Closed-Loop Synchronization](/): One-click transfer from low-stock pantry items directly into active shopping lists, and conversion of purchased items back into pantry inventory.

## Architecture & Technical Stack
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite Single-Page Application.
- Backend: Spring Boot 4.1.1 REST API running on Java 21 LTS with Jakarta Bean Validation.
- Database: Dual-profile persistence supporting PostgreSQL 15+ and file-backed H2 engine.
- Optional ML Microservice: Python FastAPI service on port 8082 with automated rule-based heuristic fallback.
